items.title: 葉倫等近50名經濟學家致函法院 「川普關稅恐讓總統權力失控」
items.title_en: Nearly 50 Economists Including Yellen Letter Court "Trump Tariffs Could Unleash Unchecked Presidential Power"
paras: 《彭博》報導，美國前財政部長葉倫等近 50 名經濟學家週三 (9 日) 向聯邦上訴法院提交法庭之友意見書，主張川普政府不當援引《1974 年貿易法》第 122 條，以「國際收支逆差」為由對全球商品課徵關稅，呼籲法院駁回這項法律論據。
參與連署者除曾在拜登政府任職的葉倫外，也包括民主、共和兩黨歷屆政府的前官員。他們質疑川普政府今年 2 月至 7 月實施過渡性 10%全球關稅的正當性，並警告，一旦法院接受政府的解釋，恐讓總統取得近乎不受限制的關稅權力。
美國最高法院今年 2 月裁定川普依緊急權力法實施的關稅違法後，川普隨即轉而援引《1974 年貿易法》第 122 條，對全球進口商品課徵 10%關稅。
該條款允許總統為處理「美國龐大且嚴重的國際收支逆差」等問題實施關稅，但稅率不得超過 15%，期限最長為 150 天。
經濟學家指出，在現代浮動匯率制度下，川普政府所稱的這類國際收支逆差「不可能存在」，政府對逆差的定義也過於寬泛。
根據意見書，川普政府認為，一長串國際會計項目中的任何負值，都可構成國際收支逆差；總統也有權單方面判斷逆差是否龐大且嚴重，並據此認定美國存在根本性的國際支付問題。
經濟學家警告，依照這套邏輯，只要其中一項國際會計數據呈現負值，總統便能隨時對全球商品課徵高額關稅。由於自該法條制定以來，相關指標始終至少有一項為負值，未來也不太可能改變，等同讓總統可以反覆動用這項權力。
美國國際貿易法院已於今年 5 月裁定，川普依據第 122 條實施的關稅違法。川普政府隨後向美國聯邦巡迴上訴法院提起上訴，目前案件仍在審理中。
本案原告週二 (8 日) 另行提交上訴答辯書，同樣主張政府的解釋過度擴張總統權限。原告表示，只要總統選擇一種在經濟學上看似合理的方式描述逆差，就能任意對全球商品課徵關稅，將使總統取得非同尋常的權力。

paras_en: Bloomberg reported that former U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and about 50 other economists filed an amicus brief with the Federal Appeals Court on Wednesday (the 9th), arguing that the Trump administration improperly invoked Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 to impose tariffs on global goods on the grounds of an "international balance‑of‑payments deficit," and urging the court to reject this legal rationale.

The signatories, besides Yellen who served in the Biden administration, also include former officials from both Democratic and Republican administrations. They question the legitimacy of the transitional 10% global tariff the Trump administration imposed from February to July this year and warn that if the court accepts the government’s interpretation, it could grant the president near‑unlimited tariff authority.

The U.S. Supreme Court ruled in February that the tariffs Trump imposed under the emergency powers law were illegal, after which Trump immediately turned to Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 to levy a 10% tariff on worldwide imports.

That provision allows the president to impose tariffs to address a "large and serious international balance‑of‑payments deficit" but caps the rate at 15% and limits the duration to a maximum of 150 days.

Economists note that under today’s floating‑exchange‑rate system, the kind of international balance‑of‑payments deficit Trump cites "cannot exist," and the government’s definition of a deficit is overly broad.

According to the brief, the Trump administration treats any negative figure among a long list of international accounting items as constituting a balance‑of‑payments deficit, and the president can unilaterally decide whether the deficit is large and serious, thereby deeming the United States to have a fundamental international payment problem.

Economists warn that under this logic, a single negative entry in any international accounting data would allow the president to impose high tariffs on global goods at any time. Since at least one such indicator has been negative ever since the statute was enacted and is unlikely to change, the president could repeatedly invoke this power.

The U.S. International Trade Court ruled in May that the tariffs Trump imposed under Section 122 were unlawful. The administration subsequently appealed to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, and the case remains under review.

The plaintiffs filed a separate appellate brief on Tuesday (the 8th), again asserting that the government’s interpretation overly expands presidential authority. They argue that as long as the president can describe the deficit in an economically plausible way, he could arbitrarily tariff global goods, granting him extraordinary power.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元小幅波動 市場聚焦央行會議
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Shows Minor Fluctuations, Market Focuses on Central Bank Meetings
paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。
美國10年期公債殖利率上升3.5個基點至4.839%。在財政部公布消息前，殖利率僅上升1.2個基點至4.816%。對利率更加敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率則上升2.7個基點至4.425%。
財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."

1) Stock market outlook

On Wednesday Hong Kong stocks fell, trading volume was stable but on the low side, and southbound capital remained net buying. The Hong Kong market is expected to stay in a range‑bound pattern, with the Hang Seng Index fluctuating between 25,000 and 26,000 points.
2) Summary of yesterday’s China‑Hong Kong market conditions

After opening flat, the Hang Seng Index plunged sharply on Wednesday, dropping as much as 156 points in the early session before recouping some losses. It softened in the afternoon and closed at 25,274 points, down 42 points or 0.2%. Turnover fell 1% day‑on‑day to HK$204.9 billion, with an average daily turnover of HK$253 billion in August.

Southbound net buying via Hong Kong‑Shanghai Stock Connect was about HK$3.7 billion. CNOOC (883), Alibaba (9988) and Xiaomi (1810) recorded net purchases of HK$4.5 billion, HK$4.4 billion and HK$3.1 billion respectively. paras_en: Pre‑market news for Taiwan stocks on September 10.

1. Taiwan stocks rose 77 points on the 9th, closing at 47,183 points, with turnover shrinking to NT$7.735 billion versus the previous day. Foreign investors net‑bought NT$20.924 billion, bullish on panel stocks as panel prices are expected to recover in early September with year‑end promotional demand. They snapped up 81,000 shares of Innolux (3481‑TW) and 65,000 shares of AU Optronics (2049‑TW), and also purchased two active ETFs – Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Unified Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW). In the three trading days of this week, foreign investors have accumulated net purchases of NT$120 billion, dramatically increasing their stake in AU Optronics by 306,900 shares.

2. The AI wave continues to drive global computing demand. The Ministry of Finance released the latest customs import‑export statistics, showing August exports surged to $82.40 billion, a record high for any month, up 9.4% month‑over‑month and 41.0% year‑over‑year, demonstrating very strong growth momentum. This marks the 34th consecutive month of positive export growth for Taiwan, with an August trade surplus of $22.30 billion, also a record. Benefiting from the explosive demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, shipments of electronic components and ICT products have been robust, laying a solid foundation for the year‑long export outlook.

3. Demand for server boards and memory module boards remains scorching. PCB makers Kenda (3044‑TW) and Golden Eagle (2368‑TW) reported impressive revenues, with Kenda posting NT$10.224 billion in August and Golden Eagle breaking the NT$10 billion threshold at NT$10.384 billion, both setting new highs. Based on current capacity expansions, both companies are on track to challenge the NT$100 billion annual revenue mark by 2026.

4. China Credit Rating released its 2026 Taiwan Corporate Credit Focus report on the 9th. While the technology sector shines, commodity‑heavy industries such as petrochemicals and steel face multiple headwinds from China's chronic overcapacity, geopolitical tensions, and trade barriers, keeping profits below the lows of previous downturns. The "borrowings‑to‑EBITDA" ratio for rated steel firms has risen to a high‑leverage range of 5‑6 times. Prices and margins for traditional plastic products are unlikely to recover soon, but Chang Chun and the Formosa Plastics Group have shown strong operational resilience, indicating that a company's ability to break out depends heavily on its "specialty chemicals transformation" and "business diversification" capabilities.

5. Amid the AI infrastructure investment surge, Taiwan’s high‑tech supply chain is demonstrating strong credit quality and operational momentum. China Credit Rating noted that continued capital‑expenditure expansion by U.S. cloud service providers (CSPs) has made AI the top revenue source for Taiwan’s tech hardware firms, directly driving significant EBITDA growth. Even with cost pressures from a globally dispersed supply chain, Taiwanese manufacturers maintain ample financial buffers thanks to powerful bargaining power and dominant market share.

6. Wistron (3231‑TW) posted August revenue of NT$460.065 billion, achieving double‑digit growth both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year, more than a 100% increase year‑on‑year, and setting a new historical monthly high. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached NT$2.51 trillion, nearly double the prior year. The board also approved several proposals, including an investment of about US$209 million (approximately NT$6.578 billion) to expand server capacity in the United States and Vietnam.
Post‑market Taiwan stock summary: the market opened higher, fluctuated, then fell, holding around the 47,200‑point level; lower volume, a 77‑point rise, and a cautious market sentiment.
Foreign investors made large purchases of the two panel giants and sold financial stocks; the three major institutional investors together net‑bought NT$22 billion.
Electronics and ICT stocks contributed 34 consecutive red‑day gains! August exports hit a record $82.4 billion, up 41% year‑over‑year.
Kenda and Golden Eagle each posted August revenues exceeding NT$10 billion, setting new highs; both are poised to become NT$100 billion players by 2026.
Taiwan dollar market: a growing wait‑and‑see mood, reduced volume, the currency appreciated 0.03 NTD to close at NT$31.505.
China Credit Rating outlook: commodity‑sector winter not over yet; Chang Chun and Formosa Plastics Group rely on specialty chemicals and diversification to break through.
China Credit Rating outlook: the AI wave bolsters Taiwan tech firms' credit quality, providing strong financial buffers and bargaining advantages.
August systematic investment plans hit a historic second‑highest level; ETFs 0050 and 0056 jointly dominate market‑cap and high‑dividend ETF rankings.
Wistron’s August revenue of NT$460 billion set a new monthly record, and the company is investing over US$200 million to expand server capacity in the U.S. and Vietnam.
Wistron chairman Hong Li‑Ning responded to the controversy over fractional shares, emphasizing priority protection of minority shareholders' rights.
Komp Law commentary: partnering with Mitsubishi Chemical to deepen the “factory‑in‑factory” model, expanding semiconductor footprint to capture waste‑acid recycling opportunities.

paras: 美股三大指數週三 (9 日) 連續第三個交易日收黑，美國財政部公布的長天期公債回購規模不及市場期待，推升美債殖利率，加上美伊衝突升溫帶動布蘭特原油突破每桶 101 美元，投資人擔憂能源價格將加劇通膨壓力，並提高聯準會 (Fed) 9 月升息的可能性。
美國財政部週三宣布，下一次長天期公債回購規模將增至 60 億美元，相當於目前規模的三倍，也是繼上月宣布至少將回購規模提高一倍後，再度擴大操作。
然而，部分交易員原先預期財政部可能將回購金額提高至 70 億至 80 億美元，實際規模未能滿足期待，帶動美債殖利率竄高。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率盤中一度升至 4.857%，創 2023 年 11 月以來新高，終場上升約 3 個基點至 4.836%，寫下 2023 年 10 月 31 日以來最高收盤水準。
美伊衝突持續升溫，市場擔憂中東能源供應進一步中斷，國際油價延續漲勢。布蘭特原油期貨上漲 3.36%，收每桶 101.21 美元；西德州原油期貨上漲 3.25%，收每桶 96.05 美元，兩者均創 5 月以來最高收盤價。
美國總統川普安撫市場道，伊朗已難以繼續支撐戰事，預期美伊戰爭將在美國 11 月期中選舉後「立即結束」。他也預測，油價將在選舉結束後大幅回落。
油價攀升加劇通膨疑慮，也推高市場對聯準會 (Fed) 升息的押注。根據 CME FedWatch 工具，交易員目前預估 Fed 9 月升息 1 碼的機率約為 60%。
市場接下來將聚焦美國通膨數據。美國勞工統計局將於週四公布 8 月生產者物價指數 (PPI)，週五公布消費者物價指數 (CPI)。
美股週三 (9 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多數走低。Meta (META-US) 強漲 6.55%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.28%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下挫 2.28%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 0.47%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.78%。
費城半導體族群漲跌互見。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 3.04%；美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.75%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.33%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 1.13%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.91%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 0.83%。
記憶體族群多收紅。SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 勁揚 7.05%；美光上漲 2.75%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 上漲 1.51%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 1.04%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 2.04%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 0.83%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 大漲 3.54%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 3.99%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 0.43%。
企業新聞
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三發表首款摺疊智慧手機 iPhone Duo、新版 iPhone 系列與 Apple Watch 產品，股價小幅走低0.28% 至每股 315.34美元。這是執行長特納斯主持此次發表會，這也是庫克離任後，他首度以蘋果執行長身分主持新品發表活動。
Meta (META-US) 勁揚逾 6% 至每股 653.69 美元，Meta 推出新款 AI 助理及獨立聊天機器人 Muse，可自動執行網路購物、管理行事曆及寄送電子郵件等多項任務。摩根士丹利認為，Meta 有望在規模估計達 30 兆美元的消費型 AI 代理潛在市場中勝出。
Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下滑 2.28%至每股 330.65 美元，Alphabet 旗下 Google 宣布將在芬蘭投入 130 億歐元、約 151 億美元建設 AI 基礎設施，為該公司歷來規模最大的歐洲投資。
美光 (MU-US) 週三升幅超 2.7%，收每股 1,027.77 美元。隨著美光本月稍晚將公布財報，投資人提前布局，加上市場出現更多證據顯示記憶體晶片短缺可望持續一段時間，進一步提振股價。
亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 走跌 1.78%至每股 252.40 美元，亞馬遜首度發行英鎊計價債券，透過四部分交易籌得 42.5 億英鎊、約 58 億美元。
陶氏化學 (DOW-US) 收低 0.57% 至每股 29.40 美元，陶氏化學據悉正評估退出與沙烏地阿美合作、規模達 200 億美元的化學品合資事業，以因應化工產業長期低迷並調整資產組合。
華爾街分析
Globalt Investments 資深投資組合經理 Thomas Martin 表示，儘管油價與利率攀升引發擔憂，股市至今仍相對有撐，但目前股票市場的樂觀情緒與升息預期同時處於極端水準，兩者難以長期共存。
Brown Brothers Harriman 策略師 Elias Haddad指出，若 CPI 高於預期，幾乎可確立 Fed 9 月升息，並支撐美元走強；若數據降溫，則將強化維持利率不變的理由。

paras_en: The three major U.S. stock indices were down for the third consecutive trading day on Wednesday (Sept. 9), as the Treasury’s announced size for the next long‑term Treasury repo fell short of expectations, pushing Treasury yields higher. Coupled with the escalation of U.S.–Iran tensions that pushed Brent crude above $101 a barrel, investors worried that energy prices would further fuel inflation and raise the likelihood of a Fed rate hike in September.

On Wednesday, the Treasury announced that the next long‑term Treasury repo would be $6 billion, three times the current size and a second expansion after last month’s announcement to double the repo size.
Some traders had expected the Treasury to raise the repo amount to $7–8 billion; the actual size fell short of those expectations, driving Treasury yields higher.
The 10‑year Treasury yield rose to a peak of 4.857% during the day, the highest since November 2023, and closed up about 3 basis points at 4.836%, the highest close since Oct. 31, 2023.

U.S.–Iran tensions continued to flare, raising concerns that Middle‑East energy supplies could be further disrupted and pushing international oil prices higher. Brent futures rose 3.36% to $101.21 a barrel, and WTI rose 3.25% to $96.05 a barrel, both the highest closing prices since May.

President Trump reassured markets that Iran can no longer sustain the conflict and that a U.S.–Iran war would end “immediately” after the midterm elections in November. He also predicted that oil prices would fall sharply after the election.

The rise in oil prices has intensified inflation concerns and increased bets that the Fed will raise rates. According to the CME FedWatch tool, traders currently estimate a 60% probability that the Fed will raise rates by 1 basis point in September.
The market will next focus on U.S. inflation data. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the August Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday and the Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Friday.
On Wednesday (Sept. 9), the major U.S. indices performed as follows:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 405.41 points, or 0.77%, to 52,380.66. The Nasdaq Composite fell 168.07 points, or 0.64%, to 26,253.34. The S&P 500 fell 37.16 points, or 0.48%, to 7,636.36. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 43.45 points, or 0.37%, to 11,931.32. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 19.87 points, or 0.11%, to 18,588.76.

In the NYSE FANG+ index, most of the big five tech giants fell. Meta (META‑US) surged 6.55%; Apple (AAPL‑US) fell 0.28%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) fell 2.28%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) fell 0.47%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) fell 1.78%.

Corporate news:

Meta (META‑US) surged over 6% to $653.69 a share as it unveiled a new AI assistant and independent chatbot Muse that can automatically shop online, manage calendars, and send emails. Morgan Stanley believes Meta could win in the $30 trillion consumer‑AI agent market.
Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) fell 2.28% to $330.65 a share as Google announced a €13 billion ($15.1 billion) investment in AI infrastructure in Finland, its largest European investment to date.

Wall Street analysts:

items.title: AI光通訊邁入第二階段？康寧數十億美元長單引爆DCI 四大投資主線浮現
paras: AI算力投資的下一個受益環節，正在從資料中心「內部」向資料中心「之間」延伸。康寧 (GLW-US) 與美國電信巨頭威訊(Verizon)(VZ-US) 周二(8日)宣布達成一項數十億美元的多年供應協議。康寧將於2027年至2032年間，提供超過8,000萬英里的高密度光纖及連接方案，同時支持家庭寬頻擴張與AI長途骨幹網建設。受此消息刺激，康寧隔夜大漲逾7%。
這筆訂單釋放的訊號是：AI基礎建設的需求，正沿著「算力—機房—跨區域網路」向外延伸。
過去兩年，AI光通訊的市場焦點集中在資料中心內部：GPU越多，需要的800G、1.6T光模組就越多。但當算力開始分布在不同園區、不同城市，新的問題隨之出現——這些資料中心之間，又該如何高速互聯？DCI（Data Center Interconnect，資料中心互聯）由此開始走向AI基礎建設投資的前台。

從Meta到Verizon，AI光纖的買單方正在擴圍

康寧的大額協議，早已有跡可循。今年1月，Meta Platforms (META-US) 便與康寧達成最高60億美元的多年協議，採購光纖、光纜及連接產品，用於美國資料中心建設。康寧亦將擴大北卡羅來納州的製造能力，Meta則成為相關擴產的重要錨定客戶。此外，康寧還與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、輝達 (NVDA-US) 等簽訂合作。
如果說Meta代表的是資料中心本身的光連接需求，那麼此次Verizon的加入，則把需求進一步延伸到了資料中心外部的長距離網路。
Verizon正在推進AI Connect戰略，在主要長途通道部署超高密度光纜，以連接資料中心並服務AWS等超大規模雲端業者。
這意味著，AI光通訊的買單方已經不再只有Meta、Amazon這類雲端業者：雲端業者負責蓋資料中心，電信業者則開始負責為這些資料中心「修高速公路」。
為什麼AI越發展，資料中心之間越需要「修路」？
理解DCI，首先要區分AI網路中的兩種連接：
第一種，是資料中心內部的互聯。GPU、伺服器和交換器之間需要高速交換資料，這也是過去兩年800G、1.6T光模組行情的核心驅動力；
第二種，則是資料中心之間的互聯，也就是DCI。
後者的重要性，在於物理上分散的資料中心，需要共享資料、調配資源及承接不同工作負載。Ciena (CIEN-US) 將DCI的應用範圍列為約10公里至超過1萬公里，反映它涵蓋從附近園區到長途網路的不同場景。
對AI建設而言，單一園區的電力、土地與建設條件存在限制，因此，一個合理的產業推演是：隨著算力部署走向多個地點，資料中心之間的連接需求也會增加。
不過，不同工作負載對延遲的容忍度不同，不能把所有遠距離連接，都理解為讓異地GPU像同一機房般協同訓練。資料同步、模型分發、備份及推理服務，同樣可以形成跨資料中心流量。
DCI的機會，來自更多算力設施需要相互連接，以及每條連接需要承載更多資料。這也是DCI有望成為AI光通訊下一階段重要增量的核心原因。

DCI需求起來之後，錢會流向哪裡？

如果把一條完整的DCI鏈路拆開，實際上涉及的不只是光纖，而是一整套光通訊及網路設備。
最底層是物理連接層：包括光纖、光纜，以及MPO、MMC、FAU等高密度光連接器件，解決的是「如何把兩座資料中心物理連起來」的問題。
再上一層是光電轉換層：這裡包括雷射器、DSP、SerDes、矽光、高速相干光模組等器件，決定資料如何以更高速度、更低損耗轉換為光訊號。
再往上則是傳輸與交換層：包括DWDM、路由器、交換器以及IP over DWDM等設備，解決光訊號如何在數十公里、數百公里甚至更遠距離上高效傳輸。
因此，DCI的產業鏈實際上比單純的AI光模組更長：
光纖 → 光器件 → 相干光模組 → DWDM → 交換器及路由器
這也意味著，一旦DCI需求真正放量，受益範圍有望從此前最熱門的光模組，進一步向整條光通訊產業鏈擴散。

哪些港股美股值得關注？

沿著DCI產業鏈來看，可以重點關注四條主線。
第一類，是最上游的光纖、光器件及底層硬體
康寧 (GLW-US) 是最直接的受益者之一。公司同時具備光纖、光纜以及高密度連接方案能力，此次與Verizon簽署的超長期合約，也讓市場首次更直觀地看到AI資料中心對底層光纖需求的量級。
此外，Coherent (COHR-US)、Lumentum (LITE-US) 則同時覆蓋雷射器、光器件及高速光通訊產品，在AI資料中心和DCI兩個市場均具備較高曝光度。
晶片環節則可以關注邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US)、博通 (AVGO-US) 以及POET Technologies (POET-US)。隨著800G向1.6T甚至更高速率升級，DSP、SerDes、矽光及光電整合技術的價值量仍有提升空間。
第二類，是高速相干光模組
如果說資料中心內部主要由短距離光模組驅動，那麼DCI增加的則是中長距離高速相干光通訊需求。
Coherent (COHR-US)、Lumentum (LITE-US)、Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) 以及港股的FIT Hon Teng (06088-HK) 等公司，均有望從高速光模組及光器件需求擴張中受益。
這一環節值得關注的核心變量，是400ZR、800ZR以及更高速相干模組的滲透速度。
第三類，是DCI傳輸系統及網路設備
這可能是市場此前關注度相對較低的一環。
諾基亞 (NOK-US) 和Ciena (CIEN-US) 長期深耕光傳輸與DWDM設備；中興通訊 (000063-SZ / 00763-HK) 同樣擁有完整的光網路和資料中心傳輸產品線。
另一方面，隨著IP over DWDM等技術逐步成熟，部分DCI功能開始直接整合進路由器與交換器，Arista Networks (ANET-US)、思科 (CSCO-US) 以及慧與科技 (HPE-US) 亦有望參與這一市場。
這意味著，DCI的增長不只是光模組公司的故事，也可能成為光傳輸設備與交換器廠商的新一輪增長驅動力。
第四類，則是最終承載算力的資料中心營運商
美股的Equinix (EQIX-US)、Digital Realty Trust (DLR-US)、Iron Mountain (IRM-US)，以及港股的萬國數據-SW (09698-HK)、世紀互聯 (VNET-US)、新意網集團 (01686-HK) 等，本身就是多數DCI流量的產生端。
當AI算力從單一園區擴張至多個資料中心，擁有優質機房資源、電力資源以及網路節點的IDC公司，其資產價值也有望被重新評估。

從「GPU互聯」到「資料中心互聯」，AI光通訊正在進入第二階段

過去兩年，AI光通訊最大的投資主線，是GPU集群內部的高速互聯。輝達 (NVDA-US) GPU數量增加，帶動交換器埠數增加；交換器埠數增加，又帶動800G、1.6T光模組以及DSP、雷射器需求爆發。
而下一階段，當全球超大規模雲端業者開始把數十萬甚至上百萬顆GPU分布在不同園區、不同城市甚至不同國家後，問題將從：「伺服器之間如何連接？」進一步變成「資料中心之間如何連接？」
這也是DCI最值得關注的地方。康寧與Verizon的8,000萬英里長單，可能只是這一趨勢的第一個明確信號。隨著AI資本開支持續向算力、網路、電力等基礎建設擴散，光通訊產業鏈的增長邏輯亦正在從單純的「光模組升級」，向光纖＋光器件＋相干模組＋DWDM＋交換設備全面擴散。
如果上一輪市場交易的是「一個資料中心裡需要多少光模組」，那麼接下來需要關注的問題可能是：全球成千上萬座AI資料中心之間，又需要多少光纖和光通訊設備？這或許才是DCI真正的想像空間。

items.title: 川普下油價預言！期中選舉後將暴跌、美伊戰爭也會告終
items.title_en: Trump Predicts Oil Price Crash After Midterms and End of Iran War
paras: 美國總統川普周三(9日)表示，受美伊戰爭影響而居高不下的油氣價格，恐怕要等到期中選舉結束後才會回落，並預言伊朗戰事也將在選後「立即」告終。
據CNBC報導，川普在前往德州出席共和黨期中選舉大會前告訴記者：「選舉一結束，油價就會開始暴跌。」距離美國期中選舉目前已不到兩個月。
川普發表上述談話之際，美國與伊朗的敵對行動再度升溫，推動國際油價進一步走高。全球基準布蘭特原油期貨自7月以來首度突破每桶101美元，美國西德州中級原油期貨盤中高點也升破96美元。
美伊戰爭目前已進入第七個月，但仍看不到明確的解決跡象。儘管川普過去多次宣稱美國已在這場戰爭中取得勝利，他周三仍堅稱，戰事將在期中選舉結束後立即落幕。
當記者追問這項預測的依據時，川普表示，伊朗「已經無法再支撐下去」，但隨後又指控德黑蘭刻意拖延戰事，希望藉此影響美國選舉結果。
川普稱，伊朗正拚命試圖左右選舉，希望讓一群「軟弱的人」取得權力，以便美國政府不再施壓，甚至放任伊朗擁有核武。不過，他並未提出證據支持這項說法，也未進一步解釋油價與戰爭為何會在選後迅速逆轉。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (the 9th) that the high oil and gas prices caused by the Iran‑U.S. war are unlikely to fall until after the midterm elections, and he even forecast that the conflict with Iran would end "immediately" after the vote.

According to CNBC, Trump told reporters before heading to Texas for the Republican midterm convention that "once the election is over, oil prices will start to plunge," noting that the U.S. midterms are now less than two months away.

At the time Trump made those remarks, hostile actions between the United States and Iran were heating up again, pushing international oil prices higher. The global benchmark Brent crude futures broke above $101 a barrel for the first time since July, and U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude reached intraday highs above $96 a barrel.

The Iran‑U.S. war is now in its seventh month with no clear signs of resolution. Although Trump has repeatedly claimed the United States has already won the war, he reiterated on Wednesday that the fighting will end immediately after the midterms.
When pressed for the basis of his prediction, Trump said Iran "can no longer sustain itself," and then accused Tehran of deliberately dragging out the conflict to influence the U.S. election outcome.

Trump claimed Iran is desperately trying to sway the election by helping a group of "weak people" gain power so that the U.S. government will stop applying pressure and even allow Iran to possess nuclear weapons, though he offered no evidence and did not explain why oil prices and the war would reverse so quickly after the election.

items.title: 邊打伊朗邊賺石油財？川普能源持股帳面最高增值440萬美元
items.title_en: Trump’s Energy Holdings Surge by Up to $4.4 Million While Leading U.S.-Iran War
paras: 美國總統川普主導美伊戰爭與停火決策期間，其個人投資帳戶仍持續買賣能源股。美國財經媒體《CNBC》周三(9日)獨家分析顯示，戰爭爆發前夕至8月底，川普9大油氣持股帳面增值約150萬至440萬美元，交易時點與多項足以撼動市場的政策宣布相互重疊，再度引發利益衝突爭議。
《CNBC》根據川普年度財務申報、企業季報及FactSet市場數據估算，從戰爭前夕2月27日至8月31日，川普持有的9家主要油氣公司股價均受惠油價與能源股上漲。
不過，由於申報資料未揭露確切股數、成交價格及賣出哪些股份，上述數字僅為依申報價值區間推算的帳面增值，不代表已實現獲利或目前精確持股。《CNBC》也未發現川普或其投資經理利用事先掌握的決策資訊交易，或川普的財務利益曾影響政府政策。

9大能源持股因戰爭增值最高440萬美元

川普的9大油氣持股包括雪佛龍(CVX-US)、康菲石油(COP-US)、埃克森美孚(XOM-US)、Kinder Morgan(KMI-US)、Marathon Petroleum(MPC-US)、西方石油(OXY-US)、Phillips 66(PSX-US)、Valero Energy(VLO-US)及Williams Companies(WMB-US)。
根據財務申報，戰爭爆發前，川普對埃克森美孚的投資價值介於320萬至1,250萬美元。截至8月31日，埃克森美孚股價上漲，估計使這筆原始持股帳面增值17.6萬至69萬美元，尚未計入其後買賣。
Raymond James & Associates高級投資策略師Pavel Molchanov表示，戰爭造成史上最大規模的石油供應中斷，油價走勢幾乎完全由此推動。石油是全球性商品，沒有任何人能避開價格上漲的影響。
川普帳戶截至6月29日仍持續買進股票，並申報至少23筆涉及上述9家公司的賣出交易。由於其後交易尚未公開，目前無法得知相關帳戶的最新部位。

攻擊後大買、停火前賣出 交易時點惹議

3月2日，也就是美國與以色列首次攻擊伊朗後的第一個交易日，川普帳戶申報買進8家大型油氣公司股票，其中購入埃克森美孚股票的金額介於10萬零1美元至25萬美元。
3周後的3月23日，川普以雙方進行「非常良好且具建設性的對話」為由，在開盤前延後攻擊伊朗能源基礎設施。布蘭特原油因局勢可能降溫而暴跌近11%。川普帳戶當天申報16筆油氣股買進交易，沒有任何賣出，總金額約16.3萬至57萬美元，包括埃克森美孚、雪佛龍及Phillips 66。
賣出時點同樣引起監督團體關注。4月7日，川普其中一個投資帳戶申報賣出50萬零1美元至100萬美元的埃克森美孚股票。美股收盤約兩個半小時後，川普宣布美伊停火兩周，埃克森美孚隔日開盤重挫逾6%。
若相關股票從戰爭前便已持有，《CNBC》估計，這筆交易不僅避開隔日跌勢，2月27日至賣出前還可能增值3.5萬至7萬美元。但申報文件並未提供買進日期，因此不能視為該筆交易的實際獲利。

白宮否認利益衝突 專家質疑並非盲目信託

白宮發言人Davis Ingle表示，川普及任何家族成員都無法指示、影響或參與投資組合的買賣決策，所有投資均由獨立經理人負責，不存在利益衝突。
川普集團未回應《CNBC》此次置評要求，但先前曾表示，個別投資決策由外部金融機構控制，川普資產存放在全權委託帳戶，且投資策略高度自動化。
政府倫理監督團體則認為，把日常交易交給經理人並未消除根本利益衝突。美國透明國際(Transparency International U.S.)副執行董事Scott Greytak表示，全權委託帳戶只是「煙幕」，並不等於真正的盲目信託；即使川普沒有親自下單，他仍可能知道自己的大筆資金投向能源產業，也會從政府決策推升能源股中獲益。
白宮責任與倫理公民組織(CREW)執行長Donald Sherman指出，總統的官方決策可以影響市場，自己又可能從中受惠，將使公眾難以分辨國家政策與私人財務利益的界線。
川普8月3日還曾公開批評埃克森美孚與雪佛龍利用供應短缺「賺太多錢」，要求兩家公司回饋民眾並降低零售價格，與其帳戶持有兩家公司股票形成強烈反差。
國會聯合經濟委員會民主黨幕僚另一項估算顯示，川普更廣泛的油氣投資組合今年可能增值最多1,550萬美元。多名民主黨議員已表示，若在11月期中選舉取得國會任一院控制權，可能調查川普的股票交易與家族商業活動。

油企獲利增至3倍 美國家庭多付715億美元

戰爭引發的供應中斷為油企帶來意外之財，卻同時提高消費者負擔。川普投資組合中的9家能源公司第二季合計獲利476億美元，是去年同期159億美元的3倍。
其中，埃克森美孚與雪佛龍合計獲利266億美元，高於去年同期的96億美元；Marathon Petroleum、Phillips 66及Valero Energy等3家煉油商，第二季合計獲利也達127億美元。
煉油供應吃緊可能延續。埃克森美孚執行長Darren Woods表示，排除疫情時期，目前煉油產能相對需求的緊張程度是他所見最高，高利潤率也會帶來更高的成品油價格。Phillips 66執行長Mark Lashier則表示，即使戰爭隔天結束，煉油市場仍將維持強勁。
截至上周五，美國原油價格約為每桶91美元，較戰前高出36%；全美汽油均價達每加侖4.09美元。國會聯合經濟委員會民主黨幕僚估算，戰爭爆發以來，美國人已額外支付715億美元汽油費，平均每戶多支出約604美元。
高油價也可能成為共和黨期中選舉的政治負擔。《路透》與益普索(Ipsos)調查顯示，48%美國人將生活成本列為最重要的投票議題，70%不認同川普處理生活成本的方式。
Molchanov指出，戰爭結束後，油價與能源股理應回落，但戰爭何時結束，終究是一項政治決定。這也凸顯川普身兼戰爭決策者與能源產業投資人的敏感處境。
paras_en: During the period when President Trump directed U.S.-Iran war and cease‑fire decisions, his personal investment account continued to trade energy stocks. CNBC’s exclusive analysis on Wednesday (9th) shows that from the eve of the war to the end of August, Trump’s nine major oil and gas holdings increased in book value by about $1.5 million to $4.4 million, with transaction timing overlapping several policy announcements that could shake the market, reigniting conflict‑of‑interest debates.

CNBC estimated, based on Trump’s annual financial disclosure, corporate quarterly reports, and FactSet market data, that from the eve of the war on February 27 to August 31, the stock prices of the nine major oil and gas companies he held benefited from rising oil prices and energy stock gains.

However, because the disclosure does not reveal exact share counts, transaction prices, or which shares were sold, the figures represent only book‑value gains inferred from the disclosed value ranges and do not indicate realized profits or current precise holdings. CNBC also found no evidence that Trump or his investment manager traded on advance knowledge of policy decisions, nor that Trump’s financial interests influenced government policy.

The nine energy holdings that saw the highest book‑value gain of $4.4 million include Chevron (CVX‑US), ConocoPhillips (COP‑US), Exxon Mobil (XOM‑US), Kinder Morgan (KMI‑US), Marathon Petroleum (MPC‑US), Occidental Petroleum (OXY‑US), Phillips 66 (PSX‑US), Valero Energy (VLO‑US), and Williams Companies (WMB‑US).

According to the disclosure, before the war, Trump’s investment in Exxon Mobil was valued between $3.2 million and $12.5 million. By August 31, Exxon’s share price had risen, estimating a book‑value gain of $176,000 to $690,000 on the original holding, not yet accounting for subsequent trades.

Raymond James & Associates senior investment strategist Pavel Molchanov said the war caused the largest oil supply disruption in history, and oil price movements were almost entirely driven by it. Oil is a global commodity, and no one can escape the impact of price increases.

Trump’s account continued to buy shares as of June 29 and reported at least 23 sale transactions involving the nine companies. Because later trades have not yet been disclosed, the account’s current positions are unknown.

The timing of purchases after the attack and sales before the cease‑fire has drawn scrutiny. On March 2, the first trading day after the U.S. and Israel’s initial attack on Iran, Trump’s account reported buying shares of eight large oil and gas companies, with the Exxon purchase ranging from $100,001 to $250,000.

Three weeks later, on March 23, Trump cited a “very good and constructive dialogue” between the parties and delayed an attack on Iranian energy infrastructure before the market opened. Brent crude fell nearly 11% as the situation cooled. Trump’s account that day reported 16 purchases of oil and gas stocks, no sales, totaling about $163,000 to $570,000, including Exxon, Chevron, and Phillips 66.

The sale timing also attracted watchdog attention. On April 7, one of Trump’s investment accounts reported selling Exxon shares worth $500,001 to $1,000,000. About two and a half hours after the market closed, Trump announced a two‑week U.S.–Iran cease‑fire, and Exxon’s next‑day opening price fell more than 6%.

If the shares were held since before the war, CNBC estimates that the trade not only avoided the next‑day decline but could have added $35,000 to $70,000 in value from February 27 to the sale. The disclosure does not provide a purchase date, so the trade cannot be considered a realized profit.

The White House denied a conflict of interest, with spokesperson Davis Ingle stating that Trump and any family member cannot direct, influence, or participate in investment decisions; all investments are managed by independent managers, eliminating conflicts.

Trump’s group did not respond to CNBC’s request for comment, but previously stated that individual investment decisions are controlled by external financial institutions, that Trump’s assets are held in a fully‑committed account, and that investment strategy is highly automated.

Government ethics watchdogs argue that delegating daily trades to managers does not eliminate fundamental conflicts. Transparency International U.S. deputy executive director Scott Greytak said a fully‑committed account is merely a “smokescreen” and not a true blind trust; even if Trump did not place orders himself, he could still know that large sums were directed to the energy sector and benefit from government decisions that lift energy stocks.

CREW executive director Donald Sherman noted that presidential decisions can influence markets, and if the president also benefits, it becomes difficult for the public to distinguish between national policy and private financial interests.

On August 3, Trump publicly criticized Exxon and Chevron for “making too much money” amid supply shortages, demanding the companies give back to the public and lower retail prices, starkly contrasting with his holdings in those two companies.

A Democratic staffer for the Congressional Joint Economic Committee estimated that Trump’s broader oil and gas portfolio could have gained up to $15.5 million this year. Several Democratic lawmakers said that if the House or Senate were controlled in the November midterms, they might investigate Trump’s stock trades and family business activities.

Oil companies’ profits rose threefold, while U.S. households paid an extra $71.5 billion. In the second quarter, the nine energy companies in Trump’s portfolio collectively earned $47.6 billion, three times last year’s $15.9 billion.
Exxon and Chevron together earned $26.6 billion, up from $9.6 billion last year; Marathon Petroleum, Phillips 66, and Valero Energy, the three refineries, also earned a combined $12.7 billion in Q2.

Refinery supply constraints may persist. Exxon CEO Darren Woods said that, excluding the pandemic period, current refinery capacity relative to demand is at its highest, and higher profit margins will lead to higher finished‑product prices. Phillips 66 CEO Mark Lashier said that even if the war ended the next day, the refining market would remain strong.

As of last Friday, U.S. crude was about $91 per barrel, 36% higher than pre‑war levels; the national average gasoline price was $4.09 per gallon. The Democratic staffer estimated that since the war began, Americans have paid an extra $71.5 billion in gasoline, averaging about $604 more per household.

High oil prices could become a political burden for the Republican midterms. Reuters and Ipsos surveys show that 48% of Americans list cost of living as the most important voting issue, and 70% disapprove of Trump’s handling of living costs.

Molchanov noted that after the war ends, oil prices and energy stocks should fall, but the timing of the end is ultimately a political decision. This underscores Trump’s sensitive position as both war decision‑maker and energy industry investor.

paras_en: Pre‑market news for Taiwan stocks on September 10.

1. Taiwan stocks rose 77 points on the 9th, closing at 47,183 points, with turnover shrinking to NT$7.735 billion versus the previous day. Foreign investors net‑bought NT$20.924 billion, bullish on panel stocks as panel prices are expected to recover in early September with year‑end promotional demand. They snapped up 81,000 shares of Innolux (3481‑TW) and 65,000 shares of AU Optronics (2049‑TW), and also purchased two active ETFs – Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Unified Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW). In the three trading days of this week, foreign investors have accumulated net purchases of NT$120 billion, dramatically increasing their stake in AU Optronics by 306,900 shares.

2. The AI wave continues to drive global computing demand. The Ministry of Finance released the latest customs import‑export statistics, showing August exports surged to $82.40 billion, a record high for any month, up 9.4% month‑over‑month and 41.0% year‑over‑year, demonstrating very strong growth momentum. This marks the 34th consecutive month of positive export growth for Taiwan, with an August trade surplus of $22.30 billion, also a record. Benefiting from the explosive demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, shipments of electronic components and ICT products have been robust, laying a solid foundation for the year‑long export outlook.

3. Demand for server boards and memory module boards remains scorching. PCB makers Kenda (3044‑TW) and Golden Eagle (2368‑TW) reported impressive revenues, with Kenda posting NT$10.224 billion in August and Golden Eagle breaking the NT$10 billion threshold at NT$10.384 billion, both setting new highs. Based on current capacity expansions, both companies are on track to challenge the NT$100 billion annual revenue mark by 2026.

4. China Credit Rating released its 2026 Taiwan Corporate Credit Focus report on the 9th. While the technology sector shines, commodity‑heavy industries such as petrochemicals and steel face multiple headwinds from China's chronic overcapacity, geopolitical tensions, and trade barriers, keeping profits below the lows of previous downturns. The "borrowings‑to‑EBITDA" ratio for rated steel firms has risen to a high‑leverage range of 5‑6 times. Prices and margins for traditional plastic products are unlikely to recover soon, but Chang Chun and the Formosa Plastics Group have shown strong operational resilience, indicating that a company's ability to break out depends heavily on its "specialty chemicals transformation" and "business diversification" capabilities.

5. Amid the AI infrastructure investment surge, Taiwan’s high‑tech supply chain is demonstrating strong credit quality and operational momentum. China Credit Rating noted that continued capital‑expenditure expansion by U.S. cloud service providers (CSPs) has made AI the top revenue source for Taiwan’s tech hardware firms, directly driving significant EBITDA growth. Even with cost pressures from a globally dispersed supply chain, Taiwanese manufacturers maintain ample financial buffers thanks to powerful bargaining power and dominant market share.

6. Wistron (3231‑TW) posted August revenue of NT$460.065 billion, achieving double‑digit growth both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year, more than a 100% increase year‑on‑year, and setting a new historical monthly high. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached NT$2.51 trillion, nearly double the prior year. The board also approved several proposals, including an investment of about US$209 million (approximately NT$6.578 billion) to expand server capacity in the United States and Vietnam.
Post‑market Taiwan stock summary: the market opened higher, fluctuated, then fell, holding around the 47,200‑point level; lower volume, a 77‑point rise, and a cautious market sentiment.
Foreign investors made large purchases of the two panel giants and sold financial stocks; the three major institutional investors together net‑bought NT$22 billion.
Electronics and ICT stocks contributed 34 consecutive red‑day gains! August exports hit a record $82.4 billion, up 41% year‑over‑year.
Kenda and Golden Eagle each posted August revenues exceeding NT$10 billion, setting new highs; both are poised to become NT$100 billion players by 2026.
Taiwan dollar market: a growing wait‑and‑see mood, reduced volume, the currency appreciated 0.03 NTD to close at NT$31.505.
China Credit Rating outlook: commodity‑sector winter not over yet; Chang Chun and Formosa Plastics Group rely on specialty chemicals and diversification to break through.
China Credit Rating outlook: the AI wave bolsters Taiwan tech firms' credit quality, providing strong financial buffers and bargaining advantages.
August systematic investment plans hit a historic second‑highest level; ETFs 0050 and 0056 jointly dominate market‑cap and high‑dividend ETF rankings.
Wistron’s August revenue of NT$460 billion set a new monthly record, and the company is investing over US$200 million to expand server capacity in the U.S. and Vietnam.
Wistron chairman Hong Li‑Ning responded to the controversy over fractional shares, emphasizing priority protection of minority shareholders' rights.
Komp Law commentary: partnering with Mitsubishi Chemical to deepen the “factory‑in‑factory” model, expanding semiconductor footprint to capture waste‑acid recycling opportunities.

和椿強調，高密度貼片與測試系統對微米級精度及良率的要求極高，和椿憑藉在半導體測試與 SMT 設備領域累積的精密驗證標準，提供對應傳動、驅動、控制與感測相關精密零組件，並將高精度運控與即時監測技術深度整合於次系統中，深獲半導體、高階伺服器、電子製造等產業客戶的高度依賴與肯定，成為推升公司營收規模穩健擴大的核心引擎，整體訂單金額與能見度也逐步增高。

據全球AI巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳指出，AI 的下一波浪潮是 Physical AI(物理AI)，AI正加速從螢幕內的文本與圖像，走向能感知、會行動、能執行複雜任務的真實世界，從輝達 揭露的Physical AI版圖可清晰看出，機器人產業的競爭核心已由傳統的單一硬體零部件，演進為「算力、模型、數據與本體協同」的全方位整合，和椿也密切關注此一技術發展趨勢，並規劃投入人形機器人等具身智慧軟硬體整合服務之布局。
展望未來，隨著Physical AI打開機器人新一輪基礎設施需求。和椿表示，對中長期營運抱持樂觀態度，公司持續發揮「半導體高階次系統」與「AI 機器人」雙軌並進的綜效，不僅深耕半導體關鍵製程與潔淨室等級 AMR 部署，並持續優化軟硬體協同能力，穩健推進全球機器人商業化落地進程，為股東與客戶創造長期永續價值。
paras_en: HeChun (6215-TW), a specialist in AI and robotic automation solutions, announced today (Sept. 9) that its August revenue reached NT$4.07 billion, up 7.73% month‑over‑month and 132.82% year‑over‑year. Not only did both monthly and yearly revenues grow, the figure also set a new single‑month revenue record for HeChun. Cumulative consolidated revenue for the first eight months of 2026 totaled NT$24.61 billion, a 59.76% increase year‑over‑year. HeChun said the growth was mainly driven by higher order visibility and continued momentum in pulling Subsystem automation equipment, which became the key engine for revenue expansion.

HeChun noted that August’s strong growth was primarily due to robust demand from semiconductor, high‑end AI server, and electronics manufacturing customers for its Subsystem equipment. As global AI compute demand expands, it fuels both high‑end server capacity and semiconductor end‑test needs, sustaining the pull‑in momentum.

HeChun emphasized that high‑density placement and testing systems require micron‑level precision and yield. Leveraging its precision verification standards accumulated in semiconductor testing and SMT equipment, the company supplies precision components for transmission, drive, control and sensing, and deeply integrates high‑accuracy motion control and real‑time monitoring technologies into its Subsystems. This has earned strong reliance and recognition from semiconductor, high‑end server and electronics manufacturing customers, becoming the core engine for steady revenue scaling, with overall order amounts and visibility gradually increasing.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said the next wave of AI is “Physical AI,” where AI moves from screen‑based text and images to perceiving, acting and executing complex tasks in the real world. Nvidia’s disclosed Physical AI roadmap shows that competition in the robotics industry is shifting from traditional single‑hardware parts to a holistic integration of compute, models, data and embodiment. HeChun is closely monitoring this trend and plans to invest in embodied intelligence services, including humanoid robots that combine hardware and software.

Looking ahead, HeChun is optimistic about mid‑ to long‑term operations as Physical AI opens a new round of infrastructure demand for robotics. The company will continue to harness the synergistic effect of its “high‑end semiconductor Subsystems” and “AI robotics” dual‑track strategy, deepening semiconductor key‑process and clean‑room‑grade AMR deployments while enhancing hardware‑software co‑optimization, steadily advancing global robot commercialization and creating sustainable long‑term value for shareholders and customers.

items.title: 迎戰50年後人口減半！國發會祭3大處方：長靠出生、中靠升級、短靠「外」援
items.title_en: Facing a Population Halving in 50 Years! The National Development Council Prescribes Three Strategies: Long‑term Births, Mid‑term Upgrading, Short‑term "Foreign" Aid
paras: 面對少子化與高齡化雙重浪潮衝擊，台灣正迎來前所未有的人才斷層危機。國發會人力發展處長謝佳宜今(9)日於台灣女董事協會「2026剛柔並濟大未來」論壇中示警，根據國發會日前公布最新 50 年人口推估，台灣總人口在 50 年後將大減 48%、僅剩約 1,215 萬人；其中 15 至 64 歲的工作年齡人口更將銳減 67%，且結構嚴重高齡化。面對人口紅利即將耗盡的嚴峻現實，企業唯有走向「全齡共融」，方能在人才變局中穩住陣腳。
謝佳宜指出，台灣去年生育率已跌至 0.695（約 0.7）的超低水準，伴隨不婚、晚婚與生育年齡延後，可生育的育齡婦女人數持續縮減。針對外界關注的人口紅利期，她特別澄清：「人口紅利看似延後兩年，絕非值得高興的事，而是因為出生數減少過快、分母變小的數學結果。」預估至 2061 年，65 歲以上老齡人口將正式超越工作年齡人口。
面對缺工擴大，政府已啟動跨部會「人口對策新戰略」。謝佳宜總結三大核心藥方：「長遠來看靠促進生育；中長期靠培育升級與提升勞動力；短中期則靠引進外國人才。」她強調，提升婦女與中高齡勞動參與率是解開缺工鎖鏈的關鍵。為此，政府正擴大彈性工時、育嬰留停補助及企業托育支援，致力打造友善職場，讓女性不再被迫在「工作與家庭」之間做出二擇一的殘酷抉擇。
「企業若能成為支持員工家庭的最強後盾，自然能突破人口變遷帶來的考驗。」謝佳宜呼籲，在少子化時代，企業應主動擁抱女力與中高齡人才，以「全齡共融」的新思維重塑營運韌性，共同化解人才斷層危機。
paras_en: Facing the twin waves of low fertility and aging, Taiwan is confronting an unprecedented talent gap crisis. Xie Jiayi, director of the Human Resources Development Division of the National Development Council, warned today (the 9th) at the Taiwan Women Directors Association’s “2026 Balanced Future” forum that, according to the council’s latest 50‑year population projection, Taiwan’s total population will shrink by 48% in half a century to about 12.15 million. The working‑age population (15‑64) will plunge 67%, and the age structure will become severely aged. With the demographic dividend about to run out, companies must adopt an “all‑age inclusive” approach to steady themselves amid the talent upheaval.

Xie noted that Taiwan’s fertility rate fell to an ultra‑low 0.695 (about 0.7) last year, and together with trends of non‑marriage, later marriage and delayed child‑bearing, the number of women of child‑bearing age continues to shrink. Responding to public concern about the demographic dividend, she clarified: “The dividend may appear to be delayed by two years, but that is not a cause for celebration; it is simply a mathematical result of births falling too fast and the denominator getting smaller.” She projects that by 2061 the population aged 65 and over will finally outnumber the working‑age population.

Confronted with widening labor shortages, the government has launched a cross‑agency “New Population Strategy.” Xie summarized three core prescriptions: “In the long run, boost births; in the medium‑term, cultivate upskilling and raise labor participation; in the short‑to‑medium term, attract foreign talent.” She stressed that raising women’s and older‑workers’ participation rates is key to unlocking the labor‑shortage lock. To that end, the government is expanding flexible work hours, childcare leave subsidies and corporate childcare support, aiming to create a family‑friendly workplace so women no longer have to make a cruel choice between “work and family.”

“If companies can become the strongest back‑stop for employees’ families, they will naturally overcome the challenges posed by demographic change,” Xie urged. In an era of low fertility, firms should proactively embrace female and older talent, reshaping operational resilience with an “all‑age inclusive” mindset to jointly resolve the talent gap crisis.

items.title: 葉倫等近50名經濟學家致函法院 「川普關稅恐讓總統權力失控」
items.title_en: Nearly 50 Economists Including Yellen Letter Court "Trump Tariffs Could Unleash Unchecked Presidential Power"
paras: 《彭博》報導，美國前財政部長葉倫等近 50 名經濟學家週三 (9 日) 向聯邦上訴法院提交法庭之友意見書，主張川普政府不當援引《1974 年貿易法》第 122 條，以「國際收支逆差」為由對全球商品課徵關稅，呼籲法院駁回這項法律論據。
參與連署者除曾在拜登政府任職的葉倫外，也包括民主、共和兩黨歷屆政府的前官員。他們質疑川普政府今年 2 月至 7 月實施過渡性 10%全球關稅的正當性，並警告，一旦法院接受政府的解釋，恐讓總統取得近乎不受限制的關稅權力。
美國最高法院今年 2 月裁定川普依緊急權力法實施的關稅違法後，川普隨即轉而援引《1974 年貿易法》第 122 條，對全球進口商品課徵 10%關稅。
該條款允許總統為處理「美國龐大且嚴重的國際收支逆差」等問題實施關稅，但稅率不得超過 15%，期限最長為 150 天。
經濟學家指出，在現代浮動匯率制度下，川普政府所稱的這類國際收支逆差「不可能存在」，政府對逆差的定義也過於寬泛。
根據意見書，川普政府認為，一長串國際會計項目中的任何負值，都可構成國際收支逆差；總統也有權單方面判斷逆差是否龐大且嚴重，並據此認定美國存在根本性的國際支付問題。
經濟學家警告，依照這套邏輯，只要其中一項國際會計數據呈現負值，總統便能隨時對全球商品課徵高額關稅。由於自該法條制定以來，相關指標始終至少有一項為負值，未來也不太可能改變，等同讓總統可以反覆動用這項權力。
美國國際貿易法院已於今年 5 月裁定，川普依據第 122 條實施的關稅違法。川普政府隨後向美國聯邦巡迴上訴法院提起上訴，目前案件仍在審理中。
本案原告週二 (8 日) 另行提交上訴答辯書，同樣主張政府的解釋過度擴張總統權限。原告表示，只要總統選擇一種在經濟學上看似合理的方式描述逆差，就能任意對全球商品課徵關稅，將使總統取得非同尋常的權力。

paras_en: Bloomberg reported that former U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and about 50 other economists filed an amicus brief with the Federal Appeals Court on Wednesday (the 9th), arguing that the Trump administration improperly invoked Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 to impose tariffs on global goods on the grounds of an "international balance‑of‑payments deficit," and urging the court to reject this legal rationale.

The signatories, besides Yellen who served in the Biden administration, also include former officials from both Democratic and Republican administrations. They question the legitimacy of the transitional 10% global tariff the Trump administration imposed from February to July this year and warn that if the court accepts the government’s interpretation, it could grant the president near‑unlimited tariff authority.

The U.S. Supreme Court ruled in February that the tariffs Trump imposed under the emergency powers law were illegal, after which Trump immediately turned to Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 to levy a 10% tariff on worldwide imports.

That provision allows the president to impose tariffs to address a "large and serious international balance‑of‑payments deficit" but caps the rate at 15% and limits the duration to a maximum of 150 days.

Economists note that under today’s floating‑exchange‑rate system, the kind of international balance‑of‑payments deficit Trump cites "cannot exist," and the government’s definition of a deficit is overly broad.

According to the brief, the Trump administration treats any negative figure among a long list of international accounting items as constituting a balance‑of‑payments deficit, and the president can unilaterally decide whether the deficit is large and serious, thereby deeming the United States to have a fundamental international payment problem.

Economists warn that under this logic, a single negative entry in any international accounting data would allow the president to impose high tariffs on global goods at any time. Since at least one such indicator has been negative ever since the statute was enacted and is unlikely to change, the president could repeatedly invoke this power.

The U.S. International Trade Court ruled in May that the tariffs Trump imposed under Section 122 were unlawful. The administration subsequently appealed to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, and the case remains under review.

The plaintiffs filed a separate appellate brief on Tuesday (the 8th), again asserting that the government’s interpretation overly expands presidential authority. They argue that as long as the president can describe the deficit in an economically plausible way, he could arbitrarily tariff global goods, granting him extraordinary power.

paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。

財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."

paras: 美股三大指數週三 (9 日) 連續第三個交易日收黑，美國財政部公布的長天期公債回購規模不及市場期待，推升美債殖利率，加上美伊衝突升溫帶動布蘭特原油突破每桶 101 美元，投資人擔憂能源價格將加劇通膨壓力，並提高聯準會 (Fed) 9 月升息的可能性。
美國財政部週三宣布，下一次長天期公債回購規模將增至 60 億美元，相當於目前規模的三倍，也是繼上月宣布至少將回購規模提高一倍後，再度擴大操作。
然而，部分交易員原先預期財政部可能將回購金額提高至 70 億至 80 億美元，實際規模未能滿足期待，帶動美債殖利率竄高。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率盤中一度升至 4.857%，創 2023 年 11 月以來新高，終場上升約 3 個基點至 4.836%，寫下 2023 年 10 月 31 日以來最高收盤水準。
美伊衝突持續升溫，市場擔憂中東能源供應進一步中斷，國際油價延續漲勢。布蘭特原油期貨上漲 3.36%，收每桶 101.21 美元；西德州原油期貨上漲 3.25%，收每桶 96.05 美元，兩者均創 5 月以來最高收盤價。
美國總統川普安撫市場道，伊朗已難以繼續支撐戰事，預期美伊戰爭將在美國 11 月期中選舉後「立即結束」。他也預測，油價將在選舉結束後大幅回落。

市場接下來將聚焦美國通膨數據。美國勞工統計局將於週四公布 8 月生產者物價指數 (PPI)，週五公布消費者物價指數 (CPI)。

企業新聞
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三發表首款摺疊智慧手機 iPhone Duo、新版 iPhone 系列與 Apple Watch 產品，股價小幅走低0.28% 至每股 315.34美元。這是執行長特納斯主持此次發表會，這也是庫克離任後，他首度以蘋果執行長身分主持新品發表活動。
Meta (META-US) 勁揚逾 6% 至每股 653.69 美元，Meta 推出新款 AI 助理及獨立聊天機器人 Muse，可自動執行網路購物、管理行事曆及寄送電子郵件等多項任務。摩根士丹利認為，Meta 有望在規模估計達 30 兆美元的消費型 AI 代理潛在市場中勝出。

paras_en: The three major U.S. stock indices were down for the third consecutive trading day on Wednesday (Sept. 9), as the Treasury’s announced size for the next long‑term Treasury repo fell short of expectations, pushing Treasury yields higher. Coupled with the escalation of U.S.–Iran tensions that pushed Brent crude above $101 a barrel, investors worried that energy prices would further fuel inflation and raise the likelihood of a Fed rate hike in September.

On Wednesday, the Treasury announced that the next long‑term Treasury repo would be $6 billion, three times the current size and a second expansion after last month’s announcement to double the repo size.
Some traders had expected the Treasury to raise the repo amount to $7–8 billion; the actual size fell short of those expectations, driving Treasury yields higher.
The 10‑year Treasury yield rose to a peak of 4.857% during the day, the highest since November 2023, and closed up about 3 basis points at 4.836%, the highest close since Oct. 31, 2023.

U.S.–Iran tensions continued to flare, raising concerns that Middle‑East energy supplies could be further disrupted and pushing international oil prices higher. Brent futures rose 3.36% to $101.21 a barrel, and WTI rose 3.25% to $96.05 a barrel, both the highest closing prices since May.

President Trump reassured markets that Iran can no longer sustain the conflict and that a U.S.–Iran war would end “immediately” after the midterm elections in November. He also predicted that oil prices would fall sharply after the election.

The rise in oil prices has intensified inflation concerns and increased bets that the Fed will raise rates. According to the CME FedWatch tool, traders currently estimate a 60% probability that the Fed will raise rates by 1 basis point in September.
The market will next focus on U.S. inflation data. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the August Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday and the Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Friday.
On Wednesday (Sept. 9), the major U.S. indices performed as follows:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 405.41 points, or 0.77%, to 52,380.66. The Nasdaq Composite fell 168.07 points, or 0.64%, to 26,253.34. The S&P 500 fell 37.16 points, or 0.48%, to 7,636.36. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 43.45 points, or 0.37%, to 11,931.32. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 19.87 points, or 0.11%, to 18,588.76.

The Philadelphia semiconductor group had mixed results. AMD (AMD‑US) rose 3.04%; Micron (MU‑US) rose 2.75%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) rose 1.33%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) fell 1.13%; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) fell 0.91%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) fell 0.83%.

Corporate news:

Apple (AAPL‑US) announced its first foldable iPhone Duo, a new iPhone lineup, and Apple Watch products on Wednesday, with the stock falling 0.28% to $315.34 a share. This event was hosted by CEO Tim Cook, his first product launch as Apple CEO after his predecessor’s departure.

Meta (META‑US) surged over 6% to $653.69 a share as it unveiled a new AI assistant and independent chatbot Muse that can automatically shop online, manage calendars, and send emails. Morgan Stanley believes Meta could win in the $30 trillion consumer‑AI agent market.

Elias Haddad, strategist at Brown Brothers Harriman, noted that if CPI exceeds expectations, it would almost confirm a Fed rate hike in September and support a stronger dollar; if the data cools, it would reinforce the case for keeping rates unchanged.
